Bank-Math-Master.question: ১) If a<sup>2</sup> - 2a = 1, then a<sup>3</sup> - 1/a<sup>3</sup> =?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: If a2 - 2a = 1, then a3 - 1/a3 =?

Solution:
Given that,
a2 - 2a = 1
⇒ a2 - 1 = 2a
∴ a - 1/a = 2

Now,
a3 - 1/a3
= (a - 1/a)3 + 3.a.(1/a)(a - 1/a)
= (2)3 + 3 × 2
= 8 + 6
= 14

Solution:

Bank-Math-Master.question: ৪) If x = 7 -  4√3, then √x + 1/√x =?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: If x = 7 -  4√3, then √x + 1/√x =?

Solution:
Given that,
x = 7 -  4√3
⇒ x = 4 - 4√3 + 3
⇒ x = (2)2 - 2 . 2 . √3 + (√3)2
⇒ x = (2 - √3)2
∴  √x = 2 - √3

∴ 1/√x = 1/(2 - √3)
= {1(2 + √3)}/{(2 - √3)(2 + √3)}
= (2 + √3)/{22 - (√3)2}
= (2 + √3)/(4 - 3)
= 2 + √3

∴ √x + 1/√x = 2 - √3 + 2 + √3
= 4

Bank-Math-Master.question:
৬) Which number will complete the series:
1, 3, 7, 15, 31, 63, 127, __?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: Which number will complete the series:
1, 3, 7, 15, 31, 63, 127, __?

Solution:
3 - 1 = 2
7 - 3 = 4 = 2 × 2
15 - 7 = 8 = 4 × 2
31 - 15 = 16 = 8 × 2
63 - 31 = 32 = 16 × 2
127 - 63 = 64 = 32 × 2

∴ The next number of 127 will be 127 + 64 × 2
= 127 + 128
= 255

Bank-Math-Master.question: ৭) If x = 1 + √3 and y = 1 - √3, find the value of x<sup>2</sup> + y<sup>2</sup>.
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: If x = 1 + √3 and y = 1 - √3, find the value of x2 + y2.

Solution: 
Given that,
x = 1 + √3
y = 1 - √3

∴ x + y = 1 + √3 + 1 - √3
= 2

And,
xy = (1 + √3)(1 - √3)
= 12 - (√3)2
= 1 - 3
= - 2 

Now,
x2 + y2 = (x + y)2 - 2xy
= (2)2 - 2(- 2)
= 4 + 4
= 8

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১০) If 4x<sup>2</sup> - px + 25 is a square number, then p =?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: If 4x2 - px + 25 is a square number, then p =?

Solution:
4x2 - px + 25
= (2x)2 - 2. 2x. 5 + 52 - px + 20x
= (2x - 5)2 - px + 20x 

Now,
- px + 20x = 0 [The expression is a square number]
⇒ px = 20x
∴ p = 20

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১১) P is bigger than J. S is bigger than M. R is not as big as S but is bigger than J. M is not as big as J. Which is the smallest?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: P is bigger than J. S is bigger than M. R is not as big as S but is bigger than J. M is not as big as J. Which is the smallest?

Solution: 
P is bigger the J. ⇒ P > J
S is bigger than M. ⇒ S > M
R is not as big as S but is bigger than J. ⇒ S > R > J
M is not as big as J. ⇒ J > M

∴ M is the smallest.

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১৪) In a certain language PENSION is coded as NEISNOP, how is COLLEGE coded in that code?

Solution:

P ⇒ E ⇒ N ⇒ S ⇒ I ⇒ O ⇒ N 
1 ⇒ 2 ⇒ 3 ⇒ 4 ⇒ 5 ⇒ 6 ⇒ 7
N ⇒ E ⇒ I ⇒ S ⇒ N⇒ O ⇒ P
Here,
Letters of 1st and 7th position inter-change their position.
Letters of 3rd and 5th position also inter-change their position.
And the letters of even number position remain same.

C ⇒ O ⇒ L ⇒ L ⇒ E ⇒ G ⇒ E 
1 ⇒ 2 ⇒ 3 ⇒ 4 ⇒ 5 ⇒ 6 ⇒ 7
E ⇒ O ⇒ E ⇒ L ⇒ L ⇒ G ⇒ C

∴ COLLEGE ⇔ EOELLGC

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১৬) If x - 1/x = - √3, then x<sup>4</sup> + 1/x<sup>4</sup> =?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: If x - 1/x = - √3, then x4 + 1/x4 =?

Solution:
Given that,
x - 1/x = - √3
 ⇒ (x - 1/x)2 = (- √3)2
⇒ x2 + 1/x2 - 2.x.(1/x) = 3
⇒ x2 + 1/x2 = 3 + 2
⇒ (x2 + 1/x2)2 = 5
⇒ (x2)2 + (1/x2)2 + 2.x2.(1/x2) = 25
⇒ x4 + 1/x4 = 25 - 2
∴ x4 + 1/x4 = 23

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১৯) If 2x<sup>2</sup> - 7xy + 6y<sup>2</sup> is divided by 2x - 3y, the result is -
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: If 2x2 - 7xy + 6y2 is divided by 2x - 3y, the result is -

Solution:
দেওয়া আছে,
2x2 − 7xy + 6y2 
= 2x2 - 4xy - 3xy + 6y2
= 2x(x - 2y) - 3y(x - 2y)
= (x - 2y)(2x - 3y)

∴ (2x2 − 7xy + 6y2)/(2x - 3y) = {(x - 2y)(2x - 3y)}/(2x - 3y) = x - 2y

Bank-Math-Master.question: ২১) A monkey climbs a 12 meters-high slippery pillar. In his first minute, he climbs 2 meters, and in the next minute, he slip one meter down. In this way, how much time will he take to reach the top of the pillar?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: A monkey climbs a 12 meters-high slippery pillar. In his first minute, he climbs 2 meters, and in the next minute, he slip one meter down. In this way, how much time will he take to reach the top of the pillar?

Solution: 
On first minute monkey climb = 2 m
On the second minute it slips = 1 m
For every two minute, it climbs 1 m
So, average speed = 1 m/2 min For 10 m,
time is taken = 20 min

For the last 2 m jump add 1 min
So time taken = 20 + 1 = 21 min

∴ Monkey takes 21 minutes to reach the top of the pole.

Bank-Math-Master.question: ২৫) The sum of values of x satisfying x<sup>2/3</sup> + x<sup>1/3</sup> = 2 is:
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: The sum of values of x satisfying x2/3 + x1/3 = 2 is:

Solution:
x2/3 + x1/3 = 2
⇒ (x2/3 + x1/3)3 = 23
⇒ x2 + x + 3.x.(x2/3 + x1/3) = 8
⇒ x2 + x + 3.x.2 = 8
⇒ x2 + 7x = 8
⇒ x2 + 8x - x - 8 = 0
⇒ x(x + 8) - 1(x + 8) = 0
⇒ (x + 8)(x - 1)
∴ x = - 8 or x = 1

∴ Sum of values of x = - 8 + 1 = - 7.
